name: Gotenberg
description: Integrates the Gotenberg service to convert HTML/URLs to PDF (admin-configured endpoint).
project_description:
Module purpose 
 This module provides a Drupal-sauce around the gotenberg/gotenberg-php package, with basic configuration and a wrapper class to be used within Drupal.

 It also adds an ' entity_print '-plugin that uses Gotenberg as the printing back-end.

 For more information regarding Gotenberg, please visit their website and documentation

Website: https://gotenberg.dev 

Documentation: https://gotenberg.dev/docs/getting-started/introduction
